assets.title: Provence or French Rose

assets.creator: Henri Joseph Redouté (French, 1766–1853)
assets.credit_line: Gift of The Print Club of Cleveland, for the Donald Gray Memorial Collection

assets.file_conversion: Full museum TIFF decoded to JPEG with bundled FFmpeg (-q:v 2), preserving full 4331x5861 dimensions; no crop, repaint, recolouring or generation.
assets.inspection_method: Downloaded/source raster opened with view_image; no screenshot, render, repaint or image generation.

authored_refinements.ornaments: Original restrained foliate opening flourishes in O0; broken meanders in PS01. Not copied manuscript decoration or a fake facsimile.
authored_refinements.didactic_relations: Original thin SVG connectors/divisio marks in selected beats only. Use the existing seek-safe draw/reveal runtime with smooth eases, no bounce.
authored_refinements.cue_evidence: Per-beat refinement_cues in visual-v4-elements.json records matched ASR words from audio/narration.json, normalized to the existing cue_scale without changing scripts.

limits: Later iconography is never a contemporary portrait or historical reconstruction.
Generic photographed books do not establish the identity of a named philosophical work. Only the authentic Summa title leaf identifies its own title.
No direct spoken quotation or source-passage highlight was added in V4. Existing narration, voice assignments, words and timing windows were retained.
Raster originals are unchanged; compositions crop/mask them non-destructively. Delivery WebP derivatives may be generated in the public bundle by the main editor.
Automated checks do not constitute aesthetic approval.
